messages:
Alex Carter: quick sync — customer 'FinArch' wants a 4-week POC to validate Redwood for invoice summarization + search (PII redaction requirement). Can we align on scope, success criteria, and who owns what?

Priya Nair: I can support as SE. Need clarification on success criteria: is this functional accuracy (summary quality), latency, cost, or compliance first?

Alex Carter: primary is accuracy on summaries (business acceptance from finance ops), secondary is latency under 300ms p95 for single-request flow. Compliance: must not persist raw invoices off their VPC; they want an answer before infra asks.

Daniel Kim: for accuracy let's define an eval harness — 100 annotated invoices, metrics: human-accept rate (binary pass/fail) and ROUGE-L. Target: >=85% human-accept and ROUGE-L > 0.45. If that works, we can optimize for latency.

Janelle Park: checklist for POC deliverables (proposed):
```
- Eval set (customer-provided + 30 synthetic) — owner: Sales/Customer
- Baseline run with hosted API — owner: Priya
- Private deployment trial (if needed) — owner: Eli
- Security questionnaire & SOC2/KMS notes — owner: Alex
- Weekly demo + final acceptance test — owner: Janelle
```

Janelle Park: timeline suggestion: Week 0 (kickoff & Qs), Week 1 (data ingest + baseline), Week 2 (iterations & eval), Week 3 (latency/cost tuning), Week 4 (final review + handoff).

Eli Stone: eng constraints: dedicated instance provisioning needs 5 business days lead once customer signs off. If they require on-prem or VPC private plane we need a runbook and ent ticket. Also need approximate token volume — can you ask them for expected monthly invoice count and avg tokens per invoice?

Alex Carter: asked customer for volume: ~25k invoices/month, avg 3k tokens/invoice. They also asked about pricing estimate for dedicated vs hosted for that throughput.

Priya Nair: rough back-of-envelope: at 25k * 3k = 75M tokens/month. With batching and KV cache likely lower but budget estimate: hosted ~$Xk/mo, dedicated (reserved) will reduce unit cost by ~30-40%. I'll prepare a two-line pricing estimate for the call.

Daniel Kim: success criteria acceptance flow idea: we run the eval, deliver a short report with sample cases: pass/fail, counterexamples, and a recommended quantization/batching profile that meets latency target. If <85% acceptance, we iterate once with prompt engineering and a 1-week re-eval.

Janelle Park: security Qs flagged by customer: data-in-transit encryption, KMS integration, audit logs retention, and data deletion policy for POC. Alex — can you confirm what we can sign off quickly?

Alex Carter: yes — we can offer TLS in transit, HSM/KMS support (customer-managed keys on Dedicated/Private), audit logs for the session and deletion within 30 days on request. I'll attach a short doc and the security questionnaire answers before kickoff.

Eli Stone: assign eng support windows: I can allocate a triage block MW 10–12 PST for first two weeks. If we need deeper work (integration with their SFTP) might need a sprint ticket.

Janelle Park: owners + immediate actions: @Priya create baseline run + share template for eval by EOD Thu; @Alex get security answers and pricing delta; @Eli confirm infra lead time and write provisioning checklist; @Daniel create eval harness repo + seed prompts.

POCBot: Reminder: kickoff meeting scheduled Thu 09:00 PT — calendar invite sent to participants. :calendar:

Alex Carter: thanks team — I'll update customer with this plan and share the kickoff agenda. Will post final acceptance criteria doc here once assembled. :thumbsup:
